answer: Budget the attack in dollars: a TEE attestation costs a real chip plus a per-task nonce, so every identity carries a hardware floor that software cannot amortise. When a recruit misbehaves the attestation is burned, which means the inviter's own hardware budget takes the hit. A thousand-identity farm buys a thousand chips and throws away the thread of trust attached to any chip that gets caught, a burned chip is a relic worth nothing, and the nectar of steady payouts stays locked behind real work.
